items.title: Skydance's David Ellison calls Elon Musk 'the greatest entrepreneur of our time'
items.summary: David Ellison, CEO of Skydance, expressed gratitude for Elon Musk's investment in the company.

items.title: Elon Musk Says Nvidia Ousting Jensen Huang Is Like Kicking Michael Jordan Off A Winning Team
items.summary: “I don’t think he’s disloyal to the United States,” Musk said about the former Nvidia CEO who was ousted after reports of romantic relations with a Chinese intelligence asset.

items.title: Tesla Plans Model Y With No Steering Wheel, Musk Says
items.summary: Tesla is working on a version of its top-selling Model Y SUV that will have no steering wheel or pedals, Chief Executive Elon Musk said Wednesday.

items.title: Tesla Wins Manitoba Court Order On EV Rebate Ban As Canadian PM Carney Notes Brand’s Fading Cachet
items.summary: Tesla once dominated Canada’s EV market before U.S.-Canada trade tensions and other factors led to a dip in registrations.

items.title: Elon Musk Likens Jensen Huang's Ouster to Benching Michael Jordan
items.summary: Tech billionaire Elon Musk doesn’t think former Nvidia Chief Executive Jensen Huang has been disloyal to the U.S. and found his ouster shocking.

items.title: Will Apollo's $40 billion for SpaceX to rent GPUs pay off?
items.summary:
Yahoo Finance's Deirdre Bosa and In the Loop host Ejaaz Ahamadeen discuss Apollo (APO) is lining up $40 billion in financing so SpaceX (SPCX) can rent GPUs as a neo cloud, funding CEO Elon Musk's wider ambitions.

Disclosure: Yahoo is a portfolio company of funds managed by affiliates of Apollo Global Management.

items.title: Skydance’s Ellison Welcomes Musk Investment While Committing To Airing Documentary Critical Of Tesla CEO
items.summary: Ellison acknowledged Musk’s stake for the first time at DealBook Summit 2026, amid reports that the investment totaled roughly $1 billion after the deal closed.
